newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Surgical extends Circon offer.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Surgical extends Circon offer.

text.p: U.S. Surgical Corp said Monday that it has extended its $18 a share cash tender offer for all the outstanding shares of Circon Corp to December 13, 1996 from September 30.
U.S. Surgical said that as of September 30, 7,393,030 shares of Circon had been tendered.
These shares, plus the one million shares previously purchased by U.S. Surgical, represent 67 percent of Circon's outstanding common stock.
On August 30, U.S. Surgical said it had extended its offer for Circon shares to Spetember 30 from August 29.
The tender offer was launched on August 2.
